meta.what: Every source used on this site, with the date it was read, what it supports and what it does not support. Sources marked OFFICIAL are operated by the league or a regulator. Sources marked TRUSTED-2 are reputable but not official, and every claim resting on one is labelled accordingly.
meta.rule: A value is only marked VERIFIED against an OFFICIAL source. Numbers recomputed from repository artefacts are marked VERIFIED-RECOMPUTED and do not depend on any external source.
meta.access_note: This sandbox has no outbound network from the shell, so every page below was read with the fetch tool rather than curl. Fetch failures are recorded rather than hidden.

sources.title: NBA Official Injury Report, 2026-27 season index
sources.supports: Reporting deadlines: 5:00 PM local the day before a game, 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM on game day, and 8:00-10:00 AM for tip-offs at 5:00 PM or earlier. Reports update continually. Confirms the index is the entry point to every timestamped PDF.
sources.does_not_support: Does not forecast minutes, does not guarantee a status will not change, and does not grant redistribution rights.

sources.title: Official injury report PDF, 11/13/26 05:00 PM ET
sources.supports: The 110 named player rows behind the /site/ injury table. Every one was compared and matched on status and matchup.
sources.does_not_support: Superseded 2.5 hours later by the 07:30 PM report. Not the latest snapshot.

sources.title: Official injury report PDF, 11/13/26 07:30 PM ET
sources.read: 2026-11-14 (chunk 0; chunk 1 not needed for the comparison made)
sources.supports: The 11 status changes between 5:00 PM and 7:30 PM, including Klay Thompson Probable to Out and Pelle Larsson Doubtful to Out.
sources.does_not_support: Covers game date 11/13 only. Does not settle anything for 11/14 onward.

sources.title: NBA.com game page, BOS at DET, 20 Oct 2026
sources.supports: Official line score BOS 113 (28-30-30-25) at DET 121 (27-18-37-39), matching the repository's first game exactly. Also confirms the official game-id format 0022600001 used throughout the 174-game log.
sources.does_not_support: One game does not verify 174. The other 173 rest on the agreement of two independent captures, not on NBA.com.

sources.title: NBA.com game pages, 14-15 Nov 2026 slate
sources.read: 2026-11-14 (game list returned while reading the BOS-DET page)
sources.supports: The 14 and 15 November fixtures, tip-off times and team records, and the game ids used on the ledger page: 0022600231 through 0022600240.
sources.does_not_support: Did not confirm game ids for 16 November. Those ledger rows have their settlement source left blank.

sources.title: 2026-27 NBA regular-season schedule by date (PDF, 'as of Aug 13 2026, subject to change')
sources.read: 2026-11-13 (prior session); provenance confirmed in data/sources.json this session
sources.supports: The 31-game window for 13-16 November used by /site/, /research/ and /origin/.
sources.does_not_support: Explicitly labelled subject to change, so it is a snapshot and not a guarantee. It also does not settle which games belong in a '3-day slate', which is why the dashboards disagree (C-07).

sources.title: NBA.com/Stats glossary
sources.supports: Official definitions of the statistic labels used in this repository.
sources.does_not_support: Definitions only. Confers no predictive value and no rights, and the remaining chunks have not been read.

sources.title: NBA.com Terms of Use
sources.supports: The restriction on using NBA Statistics for gambling purposes that underpins flagged item 7C-F-01 and question Q-01.
sources.does_not_support: Not a legal opinion, and not the only applicable term. The full document has not been read.

sources.title: Kansspelautoriteit - offering online games of chance
sources.supports: The licence requirement under article 31a of the Betting and Gaming Act (Koa) for offering online sports betting in the Netherlands.
sources.does_not_support: A regulator page, not a legal opinion about this specific product.

sources.title: Basketball-Reference 2026-27 schedule and results
sources.supports: The second, independent capture of the 174-game log. It agrees with the NBA.com-sourced log on all 174 finals and on all 9 overtime games.
sources.does_not_support: Not an NBA-operated source. Has its own terms of use which have not been reviewed (Q-12).

sources.title: ESPN core odds endpoint (provider DraftKings), single book
sources.supports: The only market prices anywhere in the repository, for a single date and a single book.
sources.does_not_support: Not a market consensus, not NBA data, and has no historical depth, so it cannot support a backtest. This is the gap behind Q-03.

sources.title: NBA injury report PDF, 11/14/26 11:00 AM
sources.supports: Nothing. Recorded so that the failure is visible rather than silently omitted.
sources.does_not_support: The existence of a same-day report cannot be confirmed from this environment. The site therefore shows no injury data for 14 November as current.
